CancelWaitingAsyncJob.title: Cancel QUEUING Asynchronous Job
CancelWaitingAsyncJob.description:
## Feature Description  
You can use CancelWaitingAsyncJob to cancel asynchronous tasks whose status is QUEUING. Tasks with the status PROCESSING (tasks that have already started processing) cannot be canceled. After cancellation, the task status becomes JOB_CANCELED, and canceled tasks will not be executed again.

> - You can obtain online human support by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or other issues related to Visual Intelligence API capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, contact us via DingTalk group (23109592).  
- This API can only cancel asynchronous tasks whose status is QUEUING. Tasks in other statuses cannot be canceled.

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages to cancel QUEUING asynchronous tasks, see [Sample Code for Canceling QUEUING Asynchronous Tasks](~~607976~~).
CancelWaitingAsyncJob.requestParamsDescription:
### Request Example

```http
http(s)://viapi.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/?action=CancelWaitingAsyncJob // For more information about endpoints, see: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143103.html
&jobId=E75FE679-0303-4DD1-8252-1143B4FA8A27	
&<Common Request Parameters>
```

Status.description:
The status of the asynchronous job. Valid values:  

- QUEUING: The job is queued.  
- PROCESSING: The job is being processed asynchronously.  
- PROCESS_SUCCESS: The job was processed successfully.  
- PROCESS_FAILED: The job processing failed.  
- TIMEOUT_FAILED: The job timed out before completion.  
- LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED: The maximum retry count was exceeded. If this status is returned, wait a moment, re-invoke the algorithm API, and then call GetAsyncJobResult to query the asynchronous job result.

ErrorMessage.description: The error message corresponding to the error code of the asynchronous job.

Result.description: The actual request result returned by the asynchronous job.

ErrorCode.description: The error code of the asynchronous job.

JobId.description: The ID of the asynchronous job.

QueryAsyncJobList.title: Query asynchronous task list
QueryAsyncJobList.description:
## Feature Description  
After you successfully commit an asynchronous task, you can use QueryAsyncJobList to query the list of submitted tasks.

> - You can obtain online assistance from [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).
- For questions about API access, usage, or other inquiries related to Visual Intelligence API capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages to query asynchronous task lists, see [Sample Code for Querying Asynchronous Task Lists](~~607975~~).

## Invocation Notes  

- You can only query asynchronous tasks submitted by your current account.
- You must activate the corresponding capability before you can perform a filtered query by category name and API name.
- This API allows only one request every 5 seconds. If an error is returned, retry after 5 seconds.
- You cannot query data older than 24 hours.
